snippet.title: Afternoon Affairs & Helpless Housewives - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Takumi Nakama is out of luck. He failed his college entrance exams and doesn’t have the motivation to look for a job. After his parents give him an old, run-down apartment building to manage, he meets two ladies living there, both with troubles of their own…
